title: GROWL
summary: Makes a bass or lead talk: a vowel that moves, like a voice.
steps: Add GROWL to a bass or a lead.
Vowel says which sound it makes (oo, ah, ee...).
Talk is how fast the vowel moves.
Grit adds dirt; the deep bass below the Body knob stays clean.
